contract: Workers registered through the unchanged published SDK are listed and described with the registration and heartbeat facts they sent: capacities, task slots bounded by those capacities, process metrics, definition fingerprints and build ID. The task_queue and status filters select among live workers; a missing worker is 404 worker_not_found. Re-registering the same worker_id with a changed workflow definition fingerprint is refused with 409 workflow_definition_changed, and omitting a previously advertised fingerprint with 409 workflow_definition_fingerprint_missing; neither refusal changes the stored registration. A later valid re-registration keeps the advertised fingerprint and resets the task slots it did not report. Staleness after the 30-second window and the heartbeat's retention report need separate fixtures. Embedded applications have no HTTP worker registration.
